name: circulation
title: Circulation desk
subtitle: Private staff review. Dates use UTC calendar days.

sections.title: Overdue loans
sections.sql: SELECT barcode,title,borrower,branch,due_on,overdue_days FROM circulation WHERE returned_on IS NULL AND overdue_days>0 ORDER BY overdue_days DESC

sections.title: Hold queue
sections.sql: SELECT title,borrower,pickup_branch,state,pickup_until FROM hold_queue ORDER BY title,queue_position

sections.title: Copies and demand
sections.sql: SELECT barcode,title,branch,condition,loans_count,last_issue,waiting FROM collection_review ORDER BY barcode
sections.note: Counts describe the records imported or entered here, not an unseen full circulation history.

sections.title: Evidence to review
sections.sql: SELECT borrower,rule,finding FROM compliance_review ORDER BY borrower,rule
sections.note: Evidence prompts support privacy review. They do not certify legal compliance.
